notes.title: V1.2 Release
notes.notes:
V1.2 Changelog:
* Hands should no longer get stuck in walls
* Players can now return to hub from final levels
* New level select UI on final portal
* Climbable objects now have a larger grab area
* Fixed some trophies not unlocking
* Laser mirrors don't move as much when you first let go
* Normal level 15 now has it's missing cube
* Final doors are now correctly unlocked
* Final hub now correctly re-checks the final portal's lock state
